name: 2/31/18 DP/Ruin Fire Brand (Human)
aplText:
decimate_soul_fire if decimation.active
bane_of_doom if target_ttd >= 61s
searing_pain if target_hp <= 12%
demonic_brand if debuff.demonic_brand_missing
immolate if dot_remains("Immolate") <= 1.6s
corruption if dot_remains("Corruption") <= 2.1s
life_tap if mana_remaining <= 41%
bane_of_agony if !target.has_debuff("Bane of Doom") && target.debuff_remains("Bane of Agony") <= 0

name: 2/31/18 DP/Ruin Shadow Brand (Human)
aplText:
bane_of_doom if target_ttd >= 60 && !target.has_debuff("Bane of Doom")
demonic_brand if debuff.demonic_brand_missing
corruption if target_ttd >= 12 && target.debuff_remains("Corruption") <= 0
immolate if target_ttd >= 12 && target.debuff_remains("Immolate") <= 0
bane_of_agony if !target.has_debuff("Bane of Doom") && target.debuff_remains("Bane of Agony") <= 0

decimate_soul_fire if decimation.active
decimate_searing if target_hp_pct <= 35 && decimation.inactive
hellfire if target_ttd >= 15s
life_tap if mana_remaining <= 20%
searing_pain
